PARA.TITLE: SRS Airbag & SRS Knee Airbag & Seat Belt with Pretensioner Outline

ITEM.PTXT: The system consists of the driver and front passenger SRS airbags, driver SRS knee airbag, seat belts with pretensioner + force limiter, front airbag sensors, center airbag sensor (computer), etc.

ENTRY.PTXT: Components
Function
Spiral Cable
Transmits the ignition signal from the center airbag sensor (computer) to the driver SRS airbag.
Driver and Front Passenger SRS Airbags, Driver SRS Knee Airbag

Consists of an inflator and a bag. In response to the ignition signal from the center airbag sensor, the bag is instantly inflated by gas generated by the inflator, reducing and absorbing the impact on the occupant.
Seat Belt with Pretensioner + Force Limiter
The gas generator is ignited by the ignition signal from the center airbag sensor (computer), instantly retracting the seat belt and increasing occupant restraint.
SRS Airbag Warning Light
Illuminates to warn the driver when there is a system malfunction.
Front Airbag Sensor
Detects the deceleration in a collision and sends a signal for ignition judgment to the center airbag sensor (computer).
Center Airbag Sensor (Computer)

Consists of a safing sensor, ignition judgment circuit, etc. The safing sensor detects the deceleration in a collision, and ignition judgment is performed based on the signals from the front airbag sensors; ignition signals are then sent to the SRS airbags, SRS knee airbag and seat belts with pretensioner + force limiter. When there is a system malfunction, the system can be diagnosed by switching to diagnosis mode.

ITEM.PTXT: The driver SRS airbag is built into the steering wheel pad.
The SRS airbag is a non-disassemblable type and consists of the inflator, bag, steering wheel pad, etc.
A service caution label describing handling precautions, etc. is affixed to the inflator.
The front passenger SRS airbag is located in the upper part of the instrument panel on the front passenger side.
The SRS airbag is a non-disassemblable type and consists of the case, inflator, bag, etc.

PARA.TITLE: Front Passenger SRS Airbag Caution Label

ITEM.PTXT: A service caution label describing handling precautions, etc. is affixed to the inflator.
The driver SRS knee airbag is located in the lower part of the instrument panel on the driver side.
The SRS airbag is a non-disassemblable type and consists of the case, inflator, bag, etc.
A service caution label describing handling precautions, etc. is affixed to the case.
The front airbag sensors are mounted on the radiator support.
The front airbag sensor detects impacts from the front and sends a deceleration signal to the computer.

The presence of an occupant is detected from the signals from the occupant detection sensor in the front passenger seat and the front passenger seat belt buckle switch, and operation of the front passenger airbag and seat belt with pretensioner is determined, and illumination of the front passenger seat belt warning light is controlled.

PARA.TITLE: Seat Belt with Pretensioner + Force Limiter

ITEM.PTXT: Pretensioner + force limiter mechanisms are provided in the seat belt retractors of the driver, front passenger and rear outer seats.
The seat belt consists of a belt retractor mechanism, ELR lock mechanism, pretensioner mechanism, force limiter mechanism, etc.
A service caution label describing handling precautions, etc. is affixed to the surface of the seat belt.

MECA.TITLE: Construction and Operation of Pretensioner Mechanism

ITEM.PTXT: The pretensioner mechanism consists of a gas generator, piston rack, pinion, etc.

MECA.TITLE: Construction and Operation of Force Limiter Mechanism

ITEM.PTXT: The force limiter mechanism consists of a torsion bar, spool, etc.

After the pretensioner operation is complete and the seat belt is pulled out by the movement of the occupant, the ELR mechanism locks and the force limiter starts to operate. When the belt is pulled out at or above the specified acceleration, or acceleration above the specified value is applied to the vehicle, the ELR mechanism operates and the belt cannot be pulled out.

When tension exceeding the specified load is applied to the belt with the ELR mechanism locked, the torsion bar twists, and the spool integrated with the torsion bar rotates to pull out the belt, keeping the belt tension constant.
A service caution label is affixed to the surface of the seat belt.
The SRS airbag warning light is located in the combination meter and illuminates or blinks to warn the driver when a system malfunction occurs.
The center airbag sensor (computer) consists of a G sensor, an ignition determination circuit, a backup power source, etc.

Based on the signals from the front airbag sensors and G sensor, it determines ignition of the driver and front passenger SRS airbags, driver SRS knee airbag and pretensioners, and based on the signals from the side airbag sensors and rear side airbag sensors, it determines ignition of the SRS side airbags and SRS curtain shield airbags. In addition, it has a diagnosis function and performs self-diagnosis when a system malfunction occurs.

ENTRY.PTXT: Components
Function
G Sensor
When deceleration is applied by an impact, it outputs a signal that is linear with respect to the deceleration.
Backup Power Source
Consists of a backup capacitor that supplies power to the system in a collision or if the power supply system fails, and a booster circuit that raises the voltage.
Computer (Ignition Determination Circuit)

Performs specified calculations based on the signal from the front airbag sensors, and sends an ignition signal when the calculated value exceeds a preset value. In addition, the malfunction diagnosis circuit diagnoses whether there is a malfunction in the entire system and informs the driver of any system malfunction, and the diagnosis function diagnoses the location of the system malfunction.

ITEM.PTXT: The SRS airbags, driver SRS knee airbag and seat belts with pretensioners are ignited by the impact of a frontal collision. The determination is made based on the front airbag sensor signals and the signals from the G sensor and electronic safing sensor in the center airbag sensor (computer).
The SRS side airbag is ignited when both the side airbag sensor signal from a side impact and the electronic safing sensor in the center airbag sensor (computer) turn ON.

The SRS curtain shield airbag is ignited by the ignition signal of the SRS side airbag that satisfies the above conditions, or when both the rear side airbag sensor signal and the electronic safing sensor in the center airbag sensor (computer) turn ON.
To keep a record of deployment, the center airbag sensor (computer) keeps the SRS airbag warning light illuminated even after the primary check. This SRS airbag warning light cannot be cleared.
The operation of the diagnosis circuit is indicated by the SRS airbag warning light in the meter. The diagnosis circuit operates in 2 periods: the primary check and the constant check.

When the engine switch is turned to IG ON, the SRS airbag warning light illuminates for approximately 6 seconds and the primary check is performed. During this period, ignition is prohibited and the operation of the center airbag sensor is diagnosed. If a malfunction is detected during this primary check, the SRS airbag warning light remains illuminated and does not go off even after 6 seconds have elapsed.
For a center airbag sensor that has deployed the airbags, the SRS airbag warning light remains illuminated even after the primary check, regardless of whether there is a malfunction.

After the primary check is completed and the SRS airbag warning light goes off, the system enters the ignition-enabled state, and the diagnosis circuit constantly checks the system for malfunctions. If a malfunction is detected during this constant check, the SRS airbag warning light illuminates. (The warning indication for low power supply voltage goes off after the power supply voltage returns to normal.)

By switching to the diagnosis mode, the diagnosis result for the malfunction location can be displayed by the number of times the indicator light blinks. In addition, a new diagnosis function has been adopted, and the diagnostic trouble code for the malfunction location can be read by connecting a diagnostic tool to DLC3. For details on the diagnosis mode, refer to the Repair Manual.
A service caution label describing handling precautions, etc. is affixed to the top of the center airbag sensor (computer).
